title: Finer notification controls
notes: Per-type notification preferences — for replies, mentions, direct messages, reactions, profile posts and badges, choose email, browser push, both or neither (the in-app bell is always on). Plus a “Send a test notification” button to confirm push works on your device, and the mobile tab bar's centre button now shows your community's logo.

changelog.text: Notification preferences — per type (replies, mentions, DMs, reactions, profile posts, badges), pick email and/or browser push.
“Send a test notification” button in push settings to verify browser push on your device.
Mobile tab bar centre button shows your community's logo/icon.
